title: Visiting list values in order
description: You can follow a for loop directly through three scores.

steps.description: scores holds 88, 95 and 73 in that order. You will visit the values stored in this list.
Each iteration assigns the next element to score. The loop supplies values directly rather than their indices.

steps.question: Which value will the second iteration print?
steps.answer: It prints 95, the second element of scores.

steps.description: You see 88, 95 and 73 on separate lines. The print runs once for each list element.
